prerequisites: Any drawing; a spot-height block is optional
assertions: each point gets a block at (x,y,z) when the drawing has the block, otherwise a point object, plus an elevation label
clear:true makes reruns idempotent on the point and label layers
points_only:false writes labels only; label:false places points only
a missing text style falls back to the current style with a warning
notes: Requires an appropriate drawing fixture. Private project runs are not public regression evidence.
